name: Tradelle
summary: Dropshipping product research, competitor store data and order fulfillment for Shopify sellers, with an AI store builder and one-click product imports.
best_for: new and growing Shopify dropshippers who want product research, competitor store data and fulfillment in one tool, and who will use the tier quotas
skip_if: you sell on TikTok Shop US/UK or WooCommerce (the help centre says fulfillment is not available there), or you want a free plan, because the only entry is a paid $1 trial
honest_knock: The subscription is only the start of the bill: every fulfilled order is charged separately for product and shipping, and Tradelle's product prices exclude VAT. The terms and the help centre also disagree on downgrades and pauses, so what you can do with an existing subscription is unclear until you try it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Lite · Lite billed monthly, 1 connected store, 25 product imports and 100 orders shipped by Tradelle a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-08 on tradelle.io/pricing, US dollars) Tradelle sells dropshipping product research and order fulfillment in three subscription tiers plus a one-time Lifetime Max. Lite is $29.99 a month, or $19.99 a month billed as $239.88 a year; Starter is $49.99 a month, or $32.50 a month billed as $390 a year; Pro is $79.99 a month, or $54.99 a month billed as $659.88 a year. Lifetime Max is $1,299 once. The tiers differ by quota: Lite has 1 connected store, 25 product imports and 100 orders shipped by Tradelle a month; Starter 3 stores, 250 imports and 500 orders; Pro is unlimited on all of those. Monthly plans start with a 7-day trial for $1 after which the selected plan begins; the terms say the $1 is non-refundable. The page also shows a 14-day money-back guarantee. The subscription is not the whole cost: fulfilled orders are charged separately for product cost and shipping, once a day, and Tradelle's product prices exclude VAT. We did not open a checkout, so optional add-ons offered there are unknown. Re-read on 15 November 2026 with a plain fetch of tradelle.io/pricing: Lite $29.99, Starter $49.99 and Pro $79.99 a month, or $239.88, $390 and $659.88 a year, Lifetime Max $1,299 once, the $1 trial and the 14-day guarantee, unchanged.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Tradelle in the 7-day trial that we started with our card and a $1 trial fee. The trial ran on Starter at $49.99 a month. Product research worked within seconds, but each research tool allows 5 searches in the trial and nothing can be sold without a Shopify store. Cancelling took 4 steps with a 50% offer and ended access at once. Account and start: we created the account and started the 7-day trial with his own card; the checkout landed on Starter monthly, not Lite. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from 15:58 to 16:03 CET, in its own tab. The interface was in English. The welcome screen said Your trial runs until November 26, 2026, then $49.99 / month. Core action, product research: we chose Research the market and the brand Meller in onboarding. Product Picks shows per product what you pay and the suggested price, for example Pay $3.69, Sell $39.99. A product page listed product cost $3.69 per unit, shipping $6.99 in 4-8 days, selling price $39.99 suggested, gross profit +$29.31 before ads and total cost $10.68 excl. VAT. Save worked: Product saved. Find it under Saved in Product Picks. Import to Shopify was not used. Store Explorer showed Trial Searches Remaining: 5. A search for dog bed gave shops such as Muddy Mat and Casper Sleep in about 3 seconds, after which the banner read 4. Competitor Research, Brand Library and Ad Explorer each showed their own count of 5 trial searches. Current Trends lists trending products. Store: Connected Stores said No store connected yet and only offers a Shopify connection; Your Starter plan includes 3 stores. A draft store without Shopify is not possible. An AI store builder was not found in the Starter dashboard; there is only a banner for a paid Done-For-You Store at $49. Connect AI (MCP) lists ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI apps, Every plan, Free included; nothing was connected. Plans and trial: Subscriptions shows Tradelle Starter Monthly Plan $49.99 / month and Your trial will end on November 26, 2026 and you will be charged $49.99. The Stripe billing portal, only read, lists a paid Trial Fee of $1 on 19 November 2026. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: Subscriptions, Cancel subscription, then 4 steps. Step 1, Features you'll lose if you cancel: Your benefits will expire immediately. Step 2, Get a 50% discount, a one-time offer with a countdown of about 5 minutes: Lite $29.99 to $14.99, Starter $49.99 to $24.99, Pro $79.99 to $39.99; declined. Step 3, Why do you want to cancel? with 9 reasons; Other reasons, Just testing. Step 4, Time to decide: You will immediately lose access to Tradelle Starter. Confirm cancellation showed All stopped for you. Your subscription has ended and will not renew. Automatic collection has been stopped. No password and no support contact. The cancel page lists 50 Product Imports/mo for Lite. Not tested: the Shopify connection, Import to Shopify, orders and fulfilment, upgrading, the Done-For-You Store, connecting the MCP, the supplier catalogue section, Global Bestsellers, Academy and support chat. Clean up: the account, the saved product and one test search stay; the subscription has ended. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Each research tool has its own count of 5 trial searches. A store needs Shopify; there is no draft store. Cancelling ends access at once, so you lose the rest of the trial.
